notes: The even of even to the shepherds is added: rule 16's appositional family requires a marker standing on the very phrase the word introduces, and this phrase is headed by ל, which keeps its own to.
הֲ takes the fronted should under rule 17, which is the אֶפְקֹד → Shall I not visit case exactly; the verb keeps only feed.
Woe unto is read as the interjection's whole rendering, with the alternative (unto added) named in that unit's note under rule 8.
